Subject: Quick reference call request for procurement pack

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — Acme’s procurement team is compiling reference calls for our Q4 review. We’re aiming for 1–2 customer calls (30m each) to validate SLA, uptime, and onboarding experience. Can you share a couple of customers who can do a short call next week? Our internal deadline is Nov 30.

If possible, please indicate any blackout dates or customers we should avoid (confidentiality/competitor restrictions). If calls are tight, we could accept a written testimonial or a short recorded walkthrough.

Thanks,
Sara

Sara — thanks for the note.

We can do 1–2 short calls next week. Putting Marissa (Customer Success) on the thread to help with availability and to flag any reference fatigue. Quick ask: do you need live execs (ops/infra) or product-oriented references? That will affect which customers we propose.

Two options I’d suggest:
- Fast lane: one immediate advocate who can do Nov 16–19 (30m).
- Staggered: call now + a backup written testimonial if customers prefer not to take multiple calls.

We track a reference rotation and throttle policy internally (to avoid over-asking the same customers). I’ll let Marissa outline any blackout windows and nominate substitutes.

Ben

Sara / Ben — following up with a realistic list.

We have two customers who fit the ask but both have constraints:
1) Nimbus Retail — can do a 30m call but only the week of Nov 22 (team travel before then). They’ve asked for calls to be limited to one per quarter (reference fatigue).
2) Atlas Financial — willing to provide a short written testimonial + a 15m readiness call with their SRE on Nov 24 only (they have a blackout Nov 17–23 for audits).

I’m attaching our reference roster (short list + preferred contact windows). A couple of policies to note so expectations are clear:
- We try to limit each advocate to a maximum of 2 external calls per quarter.
- After a live call, there is typically a 7-day blackout before asking them again for follow-ups.
- Substitutes can be provided as written quotes or 15m abbreviated calls if customers decline full calls.

Attachments: acme_reference_list.xlsx (Contact, ideal window, constraints)

If you’re happy with Atlas’s 15m slot and a written testimonial from Nimbus, we can proceed to schedule. Otherwise we can offer 2 smaller advocates from our mid-market roster.

—Marissa

Thanks Marissa — that’s helpful.

Our procurement gate is Nov 30; if we can lock something this week it would be ideal.

Best,
Sara

Sara — great, thanks. Quick answers and proposal: 

1) NDA: not required for high-level customer validation calls; Atlas prefers a simple attendee list. If procurement wants a stronger legal layer we can route a one-page consent form — I attached our standard reference consent.
2) Redwood attendees: me (Ben Carter, Account Lead) + one SRE or CS lead depending on the focus. I’ll confirm the exact SRE name after Atlas confirms.
3) Roster policy: to avoid overuse we’ll follow this temporary stagger window for this deal: allow Atlas a single 30m call on Nov 24; accept Nimbus’ written testimonial to be submitted by Nov 20. If Acme needs an additional live call we’ll escalate but will only provide a substitute from our mid-market advocates (max 15m).

I’ve attached the one-pager consent (redwood_reference_consent.pdf) and included the HubSpot deal so you can see the timeline. If that workflow is OK I’ll have Jordan (Sales Ops) lock the Nov 24 slot and send the DocuSign link for the consent doc.

Ben
